newsitem.title: GREECE: SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE ASTIR, NATL INSURANCE MERGER.
newsitem.headline: SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE ASTIR, NATL INSURANCE MERGER.

text.p: National Insurance and Astir Insurance got shareholder approval for their merger plan during Tuesday's extraordinary shareholders meeting, National Insurance said in a statement.
"The deal will be signed this week and the development ministry's approval of the merger is expected by mid-September," National Insurance, a subsidiary of National Bank of Greece said.
Ethniki General Insurance SA will be the corporate name of the new entity following the merger.
According to the approved plan, National Insurance shareholders will get 2.923 shares in the new company for every 10 held.
Likewise, Astir Insurance shareholders will get 3.5 shares in the new company for every 10 held.

National Insurance president Constantine Stamoulis said the merger will give rise to a new company with a market share above 20 percent, an extended sales network and a strong capital base, able to meet rising competition.
